usedFor: api.video hosts videos and live streams, and Freshsales Classic receives deals through “Create Deal” when a broadcast wraps up.

bestTemplate.name: “Live Stream Ended” in api.video, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A finished broadcast gives a clear moment to open a deal in the CRM.

watchOut: “New Video Created” in api.video is polling, so its deal opens after a scheduled check, unlike “Live Stream Started”.
